🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-11-02 23:00 → 2026-11-03 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **A FlashProve verifier run finished on Deucalion** — a small cluster job turned a shared research lead into a concrete result the team can build on. [tg:tawg:6040]

> **A provenance addendum entered the ERC-8004 conversation** — an entry-level bookkeeping proposal gives the trust discussion something concrete to examine. [Eleven-Entry Bookkeeping](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/434)

> **A recompute-kit review loop closed** — an enforcement gap flagged in review was acknowledged and fixed in a follow-up commit. [PR #81](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/81#issuecomment-6604221600)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### verifiable inference
_The direction shifted from a shared research pointer to concrete verifier runs and a sharper measurement debate._

- Merlini (@gobross) **Mapped the constraints** by preparing the FlashProve tests against what Deucalion actually offers, surfacing the H100 80 GB and CUDA requirement before anyone could plan an incompatible run. [tg:tawg:6030]
- Merlini (@gobross) **Added a second verifier-only round** on the same stored proofs, giving the team another data point so a single run would not carry the whole conclusion. [tg:tawg:6042]
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Shaped the comparison methodology**, agreeing that criteria should come before numbers and adding proof size and verification time alongside proving time. [tg:tawg:6038]
- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Shared the provable-inference research**, giving the verification discussion a common reference point. [tg:tawg:6024]
- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Surfaced the FlashProve repository**, moving the thread from concept to code the team could test. [tg:tawg:6025]
- Merlini (@gobross) **Kept the shared cluster predictable** by flagging an already-queued verifier job so overlapping plans would not collide. [tg:tawg:6032]

### zkIE
_The verification chain moved from a known weak spot toward a scoped repair._

- Jimmy Shi **Published a soundness-focused pull request** for committed-path verification, laying out the S1–S9 fixes as individual checks so reviewers can trace exactly what changed in the chain. [PR #45](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/45)

### ERC-8004
_The standards discussion kept tying trust claims back to concrete datasets and bookkeeping._

- sickgolf **Followed up on the dataset angle**, connecting the arXiv discussion to the Imperial College dataset so the trustless-agents thread stays anchored to evidence others can check. [ERC-8004 thread](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/433)

### recompute-kit
_The exclusion review moved from an open question to a checked state._

- Baby Blue Viper **Re-reviewed both exclusions** as their owner and confirmed both gates still exercise the live call, keeping the exceptions tied to real execution rather than a static list. [PR #87 review](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/87#pullrequestreview-5746175640)

### onboarding
_The project's framing stayed crisp for a newcomer._

- Baby Blue Viper **Welcomed a new member** with a compact description of invinoveritas as an independent checker built on signed records that outside parties can verify for themselves, handing the newcomer the core trust model immediately. [tg:tawg:6011]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**
- How the verifier numbers shift once the measurement protocol is fixed, and whether other implementations can be compared on the same terms.
- How the Eleven-Entry Bookkeeping framing lines up with the signed-record model invinoveritas is building.
- Whether the prover's H100 requirement points to a narrower, reproducible subset of claims the group can test broadly.

### ✅ **TODOs**
- Agree on proof size, proving time, and verification time as the shared measurement set before the next cluster round.
- Walk through the committed-path checks in the zkIE pull request and confirm each repaired link.
- Check whether the recompute-kit exclusions need a follow-up test now that both gates have been re-reviewed.
- Sketch how the provenance addendum's entries would map onto current signed records.

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A shared paper turned into a cluster verifier run, a second run turned it into a baseline, and the methodology question arrived before the numbers could harden into folklore.
>
> Keep that rhythm going — share, test, question, repeat — and the trust story writes itself. 😄
